name: Lomita City Council
agenda_text:
Lomita City Council
AGENDA
A REGULAR MEETING OF THE LOMITA CITY COUNCIL
December 15, 2008
7:00 P.M.
City Hall Council Chambers
24300 Narbonne Avenue
1.
OPENING CEREMONIES
a.
Call Meeting to Order
b.
Flag Salute
c.
Invocation: Councilmember Blackwood
d.
Roll Call
2.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE CITY COUNCIL The City Council may discuss and act upon items described under Council Comments; however, items which are not will be limited to Council reports, announcements, or requests for clarification, or factual information, or to placement of matters on the agenda for a future meeting.
3.
ORAL COMMUNICATIONS Persons wishing to speak on Consent Agenda items or subjects other than those scheduled are requested to do so at this time. When addressing the Council, please come to the podium and give your name and address for the record. In order to conduct a timely meeting, a 5 minute time limit per person has been established. Amendments to Government Code Section 54954.2 prohibit the Council from taking action on a specific item unless it appears on a posted agenda.
5.
REVOLVING DOOR ORDINANCE Public hearing on Ordinance No 721 which amends Title 2 of the Municipal Code to prohibit former officers and employees from representing interests before the city.
Presented by City Mgr Odom/City Atty Hogin.
SCHEDULED MATTERS
4.
CONSENT AGENDA
All items under the Consent Agenda are considered by the Council to be routine and will be enacted by one motion in the form listed below. There may be separate discussions of these items prior to the time the Council votes on the motion. Specific items may be removed from the Consent Agenda at the request of any Councilmember or staff.
a.
Approval of Minutes: October 6 and 20
b.
Approval of Demands
c.
Motion to Waive Further Reading
d.
Report recommending second reading and adoption of Ordinance No 719 which amends Section 5.3.90(b) of the Municipal Code to clarify the prohibition against the unauthorized removal of solid waste and recyclable material from solid waste containers. RECOMMEND ADOPTION.
e.
Report recommending second reading and adoption of Ordinance No 720 which amends Title III Chapter 16 of the Municipal Code to include an updated list of property conditions that constitute a public nuisance and amending the procedures for abating a public nuisance. RECOMMEND ADOPTION.
f.
Report recommending approval of a resolution denying Conditional Use Permit No 262, a request to allow the use of a contractors shop and warehouse located at 25217 Narbonne Avenue. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
g.
Report recommending approval of resolution supporting an energy partnership between Southern California Edison and the South Bay Cities Council of Governments. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
h.
Report recommending that the City Council accept a portion of properties relative to a previously approved lot line adjustment regarding the Cypress Street reservoir. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
i.
Report submitting change order to professional engineering services contract with Willdan Engineering for project management of Cypress Street reservoir. RECOMMEND APPROVAL.
PUBLIC HEARINGS
6.
ECONOMIC DEVELOPMENT Report submitting recommendations from Economic Development Subcommittee.
7.
FINANCIAL REPORT Report submitting current financial situation due to shortfall in projected revenues.
Presented by Adm Svcs Drtr Chavez.
8.
PUBLIC IMPROVEMENTS Report submitting a proposed list of public improvements for presentation to state legislators.
Presented by City Mgr Odom.
ADJOURNMENT
Written materials distributed to the City Council within 72 hours of the City Council meeting are available for public inspection immediately upon distribution in the City Clerk's office at 24300 Narbonne Avenue.
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA) if you need special assistance to participate in this meeting, you should contact the office of the City Clerk at 310 325-7110 (voice) or the California Relay Service. Notification 48 hours prior to the meeting will enable the city to make reasonable arrangements to assure accessibility to this meeting.
